newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Palawan shareholders approve swap plans.
newsitem.headline: Palawan shareholders approve swap plans.

text.p: Palawan Consolidated Mining Co Inc said on Tuesday its shareholders approved the proposed equity-for-property swap with Philippine Racing Club Inc (PRCI).

Under the agreeement, Palawan will buy two lots of PRCI land in exchange for shares. The land has been valued at 6.85 billion pesos and Palawan shares at 18 pesos each after a consolidation programme.

Palawan shares were trading at 20 centavos on Tuesday but the company plans to increase par value to one peso per share from the current one centavo per share. That would make the effective trading price 20 pesos.

The racetrack operator told the Philippine Stock Exchange the properties include a 258,294 square metere lot on the edge of Manila's Makati financial district and another 1,571,988 square metre lot south of the capital.
Palawan is majority-owned by banker Edgardo Espiritu, who is planning to develop the two properties into mixed-use commercial and residential areas.
